Tooltip_RemoteDoorOpener: A handmade electronic remote. Install a signal receiver + motor unit on an unlocked garage door, fence gate or a door you built yourself, then pair it with this remote. Keep the remote in your inventory and press the key while seated in a vehicle to open or close your doors without getting out. One remote can pair with many doors. The remote only sends the signal - it never bypasses locks.
Tooltip_AutoDoorMotor: A combined signal receiver and electric motor. Install it on an unlocked garage door, fence gate or a door you built yourself to open and close it with a paired remote. Requires a battery to work: every open/close consumes charge. Replace the battery from the door's menu when it runs out.
Tooltip_AutoDoorMagazine: Reading it teaches you how to craft the auto door remote and the auto door motor recipes.
